description: This file provides utility functions for managing browser cookies, including creating, retrieving, and deleting cookies. It includes functions 'setCookie', 'getCookie', and 'deleteCookie'.

methods.name: setCookie(sName, sValue, options)
methods.description: Creates or updates a cookie with specified name, value, and optional attributes such as expiration, path, domain, and secure flag.

methods.name: getCookie(sName)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cookie given its name. Returns null if the cookie does not exist.

methods.name: deleteCookie(sName, options)
methods.description: Deletes a cookie by setting its expiration date to the past, with optional matching of path and domain.
